title: Regulation-Grounded Visual Compliance Screening of Construction Sites: Rule Applicability Retrieval, Not Visual Judgement, Governs Accuracy — code, provision library and evaluation harness (ARGus)
description: Reference implementation and evaluation harness for regulation-grounded visual compliance screening of construction sites. Given a site photograph, a bounded retrieval agent proposes the few provisions that plausibly apply, and the verdict is computed from a named provision formula over persisted checkpoint evidence rather than from model free text, so every decision traces back to a clause. The accompanying study locates where such pipelines fail: it is the retrieval step -- deciding which provisions apply -- and not the visual judgement that governs end-to-end accuracy, and grounded precision falls as the candidate set widens. Includes the pipeline code, the 42-provision rule library and its schema, the stage prompts, privacy-reviewed sample images, the aggregate result summaries behind every table, and the paper's online supplement (paper/supplement.pdf), accompanying the paper "Regulation-Grounded Visual Compliance Screening of Construction Sites: Rule Applicability Retrieval, Not Visual Judgement, Governs Accuracy" (submitted to the Journal of Computing in Civil Engineering, ASCE).
